instruction: networkx's Floyd-Warshall functions (networkx/algorithms/shortest_paths/dense.py: floyd_warshall, floyd_warshall_predecessor_and_distance, floyd_warshall_tree and floyd_warshall_numpy) return meaningless distances, or fail with other errors, when the graph has a negative cycle. Make each of them raise nx.NetworkXUnbounded('Negative cycle detected.') instead whenever the graph (with the weight attribute in use) has a cycle of negative total weight: a directed cycle with a negative sum, a negative self-loop (also in a MultiDiGraph), or, in an undirected graph, any edge with negative weight, which is a negative cycle by itself. A cycle of total weight exactly zero is fine and must not raise (for example a directed 5-cycle with one edge's weight set to -4, while -4.0001 raises). Results on graphs without negative cycles don't change. Document the exception and add tests.
